name: Recipe Logbook
description: A recipe book that starts empty and fills itself in as you play. A recipe is written down only once you have actually made it — so 'what is all this Redsand for?' stays your question to answer. Reads the live recipe registry, so mod-added recipes appear too. Press K.
author: Matt

enabled.descriptionKey: If this row is visible in Options > Mods, the mod loaded. Press K in game.
